ReferenceSelection.bounds: Two Libraries, two existing stable Skill IDs plus a missing-ID distractor, six fixed selections, three paths, fifteen input scenarios, at most one ambient-default and one live-entrypoint change.
ReferenceSelection.assumptions: Local binding and selection actions eventually return. The immutable manifest and exact Source evidence are boundary facts; the model does not prove parsing, access, acquisition or byte integrity.
ReferenceSelection.scope: A short reference binds from its containing Library or explicit tool-entry context. Fixed selection cannot change owner, manifest or selected path. Source-relative lookup requires reliable provenance; ordinary resolution does not write. A complete cross-Library reference is valid, but an independently supplied conflicting explicit call scope rejects before selection; an ambient default is not an explicit call constraint.

ImportRelations.bounds: One explicitly selected Library, a production distractor, two batch objects, nine input scenarios, one original create per object and a deliberate-replay counterexample, one manual Members edit and one repeat.
ImportRelations.assumptions: Each create outcome is known success, accepted-with-response-lost, or unobserved. Explicit resume eventually observes or blocks; absence never authorizes replay. Initial exact candidate admission is a boundary fact, not natural-language intent.
ImportRelations.scope: Frozen mappings and tri-state relationship inputs; two-phase object/relationship application; preserved Requires and authored Members; unknown outcome recovery. It does not prove whole-tree writes or Notion transactions.

implementation_bindings.name: authoritative_context
implementation_bindings.scope: Explicit Library wins over an ambient context; a short reference without context fails. The shared parser and complete key prevent a title/alias string from becoming a second identity namespace. The finite model abstracts parser bytes.

implementation_bindings.name: exact_stable_claim
implementation_bindings.scope: Current exact Skill ID lookup rejects multiple physical claims rather than choosing the first. Source membership and complete pagination remain separate reader obligations.

implementation_bindings.name: immutable_selected_reference
implementation_bindings.scope: The selected manifest must own the complete Library/Skill key. Missing pin cannot be discarded for current. A pathless pin uses its manifest entrypoint despite a changed current kind; a missing path cannot be repaired. Cross-owner references do not inherit the containing snapshot.

implementation_bindings.name: source_coordinate_authority
implementation_bindings.scope: Original Source revision/path wins over a coincidentally mounted local path. Frozen Source route plus bytes is sufficient without a Notion File row; repository provenance and complete inventory are assumed by the finite model.

implementation_bindings.name: member_input_tristate
implementation_bindings.scope: Existing omitted Members are preserved, explicit empty wins, and first-creation inference cannot populate Requires. Exact links prove identity, not natural-language intent.

implementation_bindings.name: frozen_import_recovery
implementation_bindings.scope: Completed steps cannot regress or change request identity. A completed frozen import resumes by exact readback without recompiling or replaying its body phase. Arbitrary batches and durable crash boundaries remain concrete tests.

implementation_bindings.name: unobserved_nonidempotent_action
implementation_bindings.scope: A previously dispatched never-replay action cannot be resent because fresh observation is empty. The common kernel assertion is exercised with an unknown append; CREATE-specific behavior is separately covered by public import-batch regressions.

implementation_bindings.name: persisted_complete_identity
implementation_bindings.scope: Storage segments decode to the full logical identity. Separate real Node processes persist two Libraries with the same scope, stable ID and version, then retire one while preserving the other and its publication fence. Physical storage and SQL are not modeled TLA variables.

implementation_bindings.name: explicit_library_constraint
implementation_bindings.scope: A full reference retains its canonical root unless the call explicitly constrains another root, which fails LIBRARY_SCOPE_MISMATCH before I/O. An ambient/default root is only used to bind a short reference. The actual explicit-library-constraint mutation removes the tool-entry guard and must be caught by a cold public read, with an independent successful same-root read. Warm current, fixed and resource reads retain separate cache/manifest checks; their survival after deleting only the entry guard is not a killed mutation. Physical topology validation belongs to LibraryLifecycle; UUID/URL parsing is a concrete protocol obligation.

unmodeled_bindings.scope: URI parser bytes/encoding/case, exact physical Notion membership, permissions and denied scopes, complete pagination, native/resource/Source bytes and modes, current acquisition fences, arbitrary batches, external Notion concurrency, CLI crash/SQLite durability, packaged SDK/Broker and live-model delivery require concrete evidence.
Members means optional discoverable members. Exact active links establish target identity, not arbitrary author intent. Requires is explicit. Cross-Library relationship federation is not supported.

Authors must not reuse a deleted stable ID for a different Skill. The current implementation has no permanent global tombstone registry; the finite model does not prove identity ownership across deletion and reuse.

unmodeled_bindings.name: portable_origin_before_import_inference
unmodeled_bindings.scope: A validated portable relations.library_id is the original context of active short Skill links. Single import, batch import and members-plan qualify it before early policy returns or Members inference; only explicit --rebind-from plus an exact admitted batch identity/path may rebind current links. External, missing-path and fixed references retain origin. Without origin, short links retain destination context. Inert text is unchanged; an unsafe shared active definition rejects before writes. Derived rewrites and bytes freeze in the import plan; originals remain unchanged. Foreign nonempty relationships still fail exact same-Library validation. The portable-origin-context-preserved mutation is associated with ContextIsAuthoritative as an implementation obligation, not a transition enumerated by ReferenceSelection or ImportRelations. Its behavior assertion uses a real destination namesake, derived bytes, no inferred Member, no target lookup and zero semantic writes.
